verdicts.observation: Dense intersecting dead branches read as the fullest stage; the cluster remains distinct at 2x.
Full branched deadwood cluster has a distinct second silhouette and reads at 2x.
Reduced branch count and lower spread read as the next depletion stage at 2x.
Reduced cluster retains visible cut limbs and reads as less wood than stage 3.
Sparse crossed limbs read as a nearly depleted deadwood source at 2x.
Few remaining limbs form a sparse variant clearly below stage 2 in abundance.
Low bare patch with a few residual twigs reads as depleted at 2x.
Flat scattered twig patch reads as depleted and is visibly sparser than stage 1.
Compact few-log pile reads as the small stack, with visible cut ends at 2x.
A saturated blue horizontal patch protrudes beneath the lower-right log in the medium stack.
Broad multi-log pile reads as the large stack, with distinguishable log ends at 2x.
Saturated blue patches occupy the right edges of the upper and lower tied-stick bundle.
Few angled logs read as a small alternative stack at 2x.
A pale cyan patch borders the lower-left log end, appearing as a foreign texel block.
Numerous log ends and a taller layered silhouette read as the large alternative stack at 2x.
Upright sticks crossed by a horizontal binding read as a tied wood bundle at 2x.
